newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Park shareholders okay merger.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Park shareholders okay merger.

text.p: Hollywood Park Inc said Wednesday its shareholders have approved its acquisition of gaming company Boomtown Inc an operator of casinos in Nevada, Louisiana and Mississippi.

Boomtown stockholders receive 0.625 of a share of Hollywood Park for each Boomtown share they own. Boomtown becomes a unit of Hollywood Park, operator of the Hollywood Park Race Track, Hollywood Park Casino and Turf Paradise Inc.
"The Boomtown merger represents a major step in the growth strategy of Hollywood Park," R.D. Hubbard, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
He noted Hollywood Park will continue to acquire and develop gambling and entertainment facilities in its effort to become a national gaming and entertainment company."

Expansion is planned for the Boomtown casinos in Reno, New Orleans, and depending upon market conditions, Biloxi, Miss. The Reno and New Orleans expansions are expected to move ahead rapidly after the merger, which is expected to be finished in the first quarter of 1997.
In other business, shareholders re-elected the seven members of the Hollywood Park board to one-year terms and approved the Hollywood Park 1996 Stock Option Plan.
